name: NormArithmetic.conjugate_product
statement: theorem conjugate_product {R : Type} [CommRing R] (n a b : R) : a*a+n*b*(-b) = a^2-n*b^2 ∧ a*(-b)+b*a = 0

name: NormArithmetic.scaled_conjugate_inverse
statement: theorem scaled_conjugate_inverse {R : Type} [CommRing R] (n a b t : R) (h : (a^2-n*b^2)*t = 1) : a*(a*t)+n*b*(-(b*t)) = 1 ∧ a*(-(b*t))+b*(a*t) = 0

name: NormArithmetic.inverse_pair_norm
statement: theorem inverse_pair_norm {R : Type} [CommRing R] (n a b t : R) (h : (a^2-n*b^2)*t = 1) : (a*t)^2-n*(-(b*t))^2 = t
